goals.0: All the forms of haben: ich habe, du hast, er hat …
goals.3: Words for married / single, friends and relatives
dialog.1.de.8.n: Freundin = female friend; depending on the context it can also mean “girlfriend”
dialog.3.de.2.n: Onkel covers every kind of uncle (father's brother, mother's brother …)
grammar.0.intro: haben (to have) is one of the most useful verbs. With du and er/sie/es the b disappears — it breaks the pattern.
grammar.0.note: In Bangla you say “amar ekta bhai ache” (literally “to me a brother is”), but in German the subject is “I”: Ich habe einen Bruder.
grammar.1.title: After haben: ein → einen (masculine only)
grammar.1.intro: What comes after haben is in the Akkusativ. Of the three genders, only der-words change.
grammar.1.note: Ich habe einen Bruder (I have a brother) — but Das ist ein Bruder.
quiz.3.why: With du: du hast (the b disappears).
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “Do you have a photo?”
quiz.7.why: In a question the verb comes first: Hast du ein Foto?
